# Map the General

> Unofficial, sourced election pages for first-world countries. Spain’s general election is Sunday, 29 November 2026. Map the General is a brand of Joshua Israel Ventures LLC. Not an official election website. Map the General is a brand of Joshua Israel Ventures LLC. Business address: 5640 W Maple Rd, Ste 101, West Bloomfield, MI 48322. Unofficial information. Confirm with your official election office.
